name: Antelopus Selan Energy Ltd (formerly Selan Exploration Technology Ltd)
tagline: Small, debt-free oil & gas E&P (legacy Bakrol/Lohar/Karjisan Gujarat fields) posting strong 54% revenue growth, now under a new controlling promoter (Blackbuck Energy/Antelopus, ~69.9% stake via an NCLT-approved scheme) - real numbers, but too early to underwrite a specific growth thesis under the new ownership.
business_overview: Originally Selan Exploration Technology Ltd, one of the first private companies to secure development rights for the Bakrol, Lohar and Karjisan discovered oilfields in Gujarat (1985 legacy). Renamed to Antelopus Selan Energy Ltd in August 2025 after Antelopus Energy Private Limited (founded 2018, an oil & gas-focused platform) acquired control via a Composite Scheme of Arrangement approved by the NCLT, with promoter entity Blackbuck Energy Investments Limited allotted shares taking its stake to ~69.93%. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@rdkriplani, bullish view, medium conviction, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_table: New promoter Blackbuck Energy Investments Ltd holds ~69.93% post NCLT-approved scheme (Aug 2025 rename, control change effective Jul 2025)
fundamentals_narrative: The underlying legacy business (small, debt-free, producing Gujarat oilfields) shows genuinely strong recent revenue growth (~54%) and respectable capital efficiency (ROCE ~11.6%, ROE ~13.4%), and the stock has corrected sharply from its 52-week high (~Rs 1,079 to ~Rs 577), improving the entry math versus a year ago. However, this is now effectively a different controlled entity: Antelopus Energy Private Limited took control via an NCLT-approved Composite Scheme of Arrangement (completed July 2025, name changed August 2025), with promoter stake raised to ~69.93% - a legitimate, disclosed transaction, not a red-flag promoter-collapse event, but it does mean the pre-existing legacy financial trend may not predict the new promoter's forward strategy for the asset base. No specific new growth plan, capex program, or production-ramp target under the new ownership was found this pass.
